findings.title: Website name bypasses the TL0 anonymous-field restriction
findings.body: `website` is explicitly treated as an untrusted attribute and omitted for anonymous viewers of TL0 users, but the newly serialized `website_name` is not. Since `website_name` is derived from that same profile URL, anonymous requests can still reveal the website host (and, for matching domains, its path) through the profile display name even when the URL itself is hidden. Add `website_name` to the untrusted attributes so it follows the same visibility policy.
